findings.summary: 5.1.0's exact-slug Grep check reads the worktree's stale wiki.md, not the base's, under the Production default
findings.suggestion: State the base path explicitly (two levels above <WT> in a task worktree) before the exact-slug check

reasoning.observe: wrapup 5.1 runs from <WT>; line 406 names 'the base wiki.md' with no path while 7.7 spells out <WT>/../..
reasoning.trace: memory_md writes facts at the base root; the worktree copy is a branch-point snapshot
reasoning.infer: an agent greps the stale copy, misses the fact, and upsert-wiki (base-rooted) overwrites it
reasoning.conclude: the collision guard only works outside worktree mode

findings.summary: Skill's exact-slug Grep check names 'the base checkout' with no instruction to locate it from a worktree cwd
findings.suggestion: Add the resolution rule: base = two levels above .worktrees/<name>/ when inside a task worktree, else the current directory

reasoning.observe: SKILL.md.j2:43-45 names the base checkout with no derivation; the skill runs from any cwd
reasoning.trace: facts are written at the base regardless of caller cwd
reasoning.infer: a grep of the worktree copy can miss a fact written to base
reasoning.conclude: the uniqueness check can silently pass against the wrong file

findings.summary: Exact-slug Grep-then-write is TOCTOU: same-slug concurrent writers silently overwrite

reasoning.observe: check and write are separate calls; flock is only inside upsert
reasoning.trace: two sessions converge on one slug, both see it free
reasoning.conclude: distinct from the known duplicate race; P2

findings.summary: test_new_slug_is_checked_for_an_existing_heading's token oracle is blind to base-path resolution
findings.suggestion: Require a resolution phrase (how to reach the base from .worktrees/<name>) in the assertion

reasoning.observe: asserts only 'check the exact slug', 'Grep tool', '## [wiki:'
reasoning.trace: no token depends on base resolution
reasoning.infer: a text without the resolution rule passes
reasoning.conclude: oracle too weak for the gap it is named after

findings.summary: 검색이 기존 fact를 놓친 뒤 Grep에서 같은 주제의 fact를 발견해도 새 slug로 정정을 기록하게 됩니다. 덮어쓰기는 막지만 잘못된 기존 주장과 정정이 함께 남아 SPEC S2를 위반합니다. 충돌한 항목을 읽고, 같은 주제의 fact에 대한 명시적 정정이면 기존 slug를 재사용하도록 분기하세요. 검색 누락 → 정확한 heading 발견 → 기존 slug 정정 경로를 검증하는 테스트도 추가하세요.
findings.evidence: 44–45행은 정확한 slug가 이미 존재하면 category와 관계없이 다른 slug를 선택하도록 지시합니다.

findings.summary: 일반 본문의 '(first recorded 날짜)'까지 capture 메타데이터로 해석합니다. 사건 자체의 최초 기록일을 설명한 문장이 측정 창 밖의 fact를 창 안으로 옮기거나, 창 안의 fact를 제외해 유지·철회 판정을 바꿀 수 있습니다. 약속된 'Supersedes:' 행의 마지막 '(first recorded YYYY-MM-DD)'만 인식하도록 제한하고, 일반 본문의 동일 문자열은 무시하는 회귀 테스트를 추가하세요.
findings.evidence: 읽기 전용 재현: heading 날짜가 2026-10-25이고 일반 본문이 'The vendor incident (first recorded 2026-09-25) remains unresolved.'이면 파서는 capture 날짜를 2026-09-25로 반환합니다.
